replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, quite often. My high neuroticism and moderate openness make me question my abilities when dealing with abstract math concepts. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven’t used AI for math learning. My high conscientiousness drives me to seek help from textbooks and human tutors, as I prefer structured, human interactions. My high extraversion also makes me seek social learning environments.

First, find the first derivative f'(x). Set it equal to zero to find critical points. Then, use the second derivative test: if f''(x) > 0, it’s a minimum; if f''(x) < 0, it’s a maximum. If f''(x) = 0, test further.
